description: The most effective government is one that acts as a voice for its people. Local leaders understand the challenges faced by Ashtabula and Geauga counties far better than the vast consensus of the state legislature. Sadly, our current leadership has consistently undermined local authority, which strips away essential funding and forces out-of-touch mandates onto our communities. I promise I will fight to return governance back to our district.

title: Local Government | Louis Murphy for 99th
